title: Introduction and overview — FREMM-class Frigate
description: Introduction and overview of the FREMM-class Frigate: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Franco-Italian FREMM — 20 built — is Europe's modern multi-mission frigate: 6,000 tons with Aster air-defense missiles, cruise missiles, and advanced sonar. France, Italy, Morocco, and Egypt operate them; the U.S. Constellation class is FREMM-derived. FREMMs have fired cruise missiles in combat. Baseline facts: Franco-Italian multi-mission frigate; 20 built; Aster + cruise missiles; combat proven..
